text: Church encodings in System F allow the definition of all data types (booleans, products, sums, lists) without adding type constructors.
explanation: Church encodings: ∀α.α→α→α (bool), ∀α.α→(α→α)→α (nat), etc. System F is expressive enough to encode these, though the encodings for negative types (like general recursion) require care.
